scientific_integrity: New asymptotic and analytic uniqueness claims are explicitly distinguished from established renewal and queue-stability formulas; verification is self-review only; no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive diffusivity, interval length and service rate; homogeneous servers; zero refractory delay; asymptotic only as integer server count tends to infinity. Earlier source already derived implicit crossover equation. Exact individual finite-server values are not tabulated here.
title: Sharp logarithmic high-server crossover in stochastic-reset search queues
